description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractMigration' which provides a framework for database schema migrations within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for managing schema, data, language, and configuration helpers, and defines abstract methods for applying migrations and retrieving version info.

classes.name: AbstractMigration
classes.description: An abstract class providing mechanisms for database migration tasks, including schema management, data handling, language support, and configuration management within the OrangeHRM installer.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Returns the schema manager object for database schema operations.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Provides access to the database connection used for executing queries.

methods.name: createQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new query builder instance for constructing SQL queries.

methods.name: getSchemaHelper
methods.description: Returns a SchemaHelper instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getDataGroupHelper
methods.description: Returns a DataGroupHelper instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getLangHelper
methods.description: Returns a LanguageHelper instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getConfigHelper
methods.description: Returns a ConfigHelper instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Abstract method to define schema or data changes for migration.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Abstract method to return the migration version as a string.
